versions.content: A call of Dem_J1939DcmReadDiagnosticReadiness2 shall report a response message based on the J1939-73 [14] DM21 definition: • Distance Traveled While MIL is Activated shall be identical to PID 0x21, except the maximum value is 64255 (all values above 64255 shall be reported as 64255). • Distance Since Diagnostic Trouble Codes Cleared shall be identical to PID 0x31, except the maximum value is 64255 (all values above 64255 shall be reported as 64255). • Minutes Run by Engine While MIL is Activated shall be identical to PID 0x4D, except the maximum value is 64255 (all values above 64255 shall be reported as 64255). • Time Since Diagnostic Trouble Codes Cleared shall be identical to PID 0x4E, except the maximum value is 64255 (all values above 64255 shall be reported as 64255).
